a: WebRTC enables real-time audio, video, and data between peers in browsers and apps.
Signaling exchanges SDP offers/answers and ICE candidates via your server.
ICE finds network paths (host, srflx, relay) for connectivity.
STUN discovers public addresses; TURN relays when direct peer paths fail.
DataChannels send arbitrary data peer-to-peer with optional reliability.
MediaStream tracks capture microphone/camera for sending.
Mesh connects everyone to everyone; SFU forwards media more scalably.
DTLS/SRTP encrypt media; authenticate signaling endpoints carefully.
Congestion control adapts media quality to network conditions.
Video calls, live streaming contributions, screen share, and low-latency games.
